name: CHIME/FRB Fast Radio Burst Catalog
description: The first CHIME/FRB catalog of 536 fast radio bursts detected from 2018 July to 2019 July, including bursts from repeating and apparently non-repeating sources.
citation: The CHIME/FRB Collaboration. (2021). The First CHIME/FRB Fast Radio Burst Catalog. The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series, 257(2), 59. https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4365/ac33ab
